name: english-spoiler-eval
description: A held-out evaluation set for spoiler decisions on English synthetic mystery micro-narratives.
rights_note: Dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. 100% synthetic text authored for Mixu.

source_texts.title: The Cipher of Blackwood Manor
source_texts.description: Lord Blackwood is poisoned by curare inside his locked study; the safe will is replaced by a coded parchment, pointing to an unacknowledged heir.

source_texts.title: The Vanishing Emerald of the Silver Express
source_texts.description: A blizzard halts an express train across the moors; Lady Catherine's emerald necklace vanishes from a locked sleeper compartment in an insurance conspiracy.

source_texts.title: The Riddle of the Hollow Clock
source_texts.description: An antiquarian falls to his death from St. Jude's bell tower; the escapement mechanism was corroded with acid and jammed by an ivory chess piece.
